title: quantum-encoding-bottlenecks: reproduction code for 'How Quantum Data Encoding Constrains Representation Learning'
description: Reproduction code for the Quantum Machine Intelligence article. Simulates angle encoding with data re-uploading, amplitude embedding and the quantum spectral model (QSM) on five classification tasks, and measures where accuracy is lost along the pipeline: in pooling, in the function class of the encoding, or in training. All simulations are noiseless and use exact expectation values.
